critical_code_review_comments: Delete confirmation input uses `confirm.trim().toUpperCase() !== 'DELETE'` — this means the user typing lowercase 'delete' also enables the destructive action. The review spec said 'becomes enabled only when the input matches DELETE' (case-sensitive). Consider dropping .toUpperCase() for a stricter Apple-review-friendly confirmation, though current UX is arguably more forgiving. Non-blocking.
